answer: One concrete defense is pricing identity with a slashable bond plus delayed withdrawal. Each agent must lock capital proportional to the voting weight it wants, and any proven sock puppet loses the stake. Registering ten thousand Sybils therefore costs ten thousand bonds, held for weeks, while honest agents post once and earn yield. Attestation is rate-limited per bond unit, so a fake crowd cannot snowball. A small honest cluster stays a lantern in the dark; a funded attacker buys only an oasis that dries up, and a garden nobody can harvest.
